caption: Bregninge Church, Bregninge
composition: A red-brick hill church and a lantern spire · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Bregninge Church stands on the rounded hill: red brick, dark slate roofs, and a west tower with a low octagonal roof and a tall lantern spire. The lane is empty. The night is overcast, about 10.7°C. The cloud deck hides the moon, and a few lamps carry the light. The sea is not the close subject.
